newsitem.title: ITALY: FORECAST - Italy mkt sees o/n rate down in one month.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Italy mkt sees o/n rate down in one month.

text.p: Italy's money market continues to expect overnight rates to fall below the official 7.5 percent discount rate in the course of the next month, a study by the Bocconi University research arm, Igier, showed on Friday.

The study, based on implicit overnight rates, shows the implicit overnight rate at 7.37 percent in a month's time from an official market close of 7.75 percent on Thursday, the day on which the study was based.
One week ago the implicit overnight rate over the same timeframe was seen at 7.5 percent.
Three months out the implicit overnight rate is seen at 6.77 percent from 6.84 a week ago and 6.63 percent last month.

On a one year timeframe the implicit overnight rate is seen at 5.72 percent from 5.91 last week and 5.94 a month ago. On a two year timeframe the implicit rate is seen at 6.11 percent from 6.53 seven days ago and 6.65 percent a month ago.

The spread between the implicit Italian overnight rate in two years' time and the implicit German overnight rate over the same horizon, which is seen as a good indicator of confidence in Europe's economic and monetary union, this week stands at 167 basis points from 191 last week and 194 a month ago.
This week the spread between 10 year Btps and 10 year Bunds touched a new record low of 150 basis points. On Friday this differential was 156 basis points.
